summary_1line: After Abhimanyu’s death, rites are performed, Vyasa foretells his unborn son’s future rule, and Yudhishthira plans to retrieve Marutta’s buried wealth for a horse-sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna distributes vast heaps of gold, cattle, clothes, and beds to thousands of Brahmanas during Abhimanyu’s funeral rites.
The sage Vyasa appears in the grieving court, assuring Uttara that the child in her womb will one day rule the earth.
The Pandavas set out after worshipping Shiva, their army marching under the star Dhruba to recover Marutta’s buried treasure.
